scope: Original Codex-authored TRAIN-only bilingual sources. Written from aggregate supervision gaps, not DEV answers or their rewrites. Same AI authors and reviews; no human-review claim. Pending conservative overlap audit before training use.

sources.en: The parcel locker will hold the camera battery for two days after the collection code arrives. Receiving the code does not mean that someone has already collected the battery.
sources.zh: 取件码送达后，包裹柜会将相机电池保留两天。收到取件码并不意味着已经有人取走了电池。
sources.context: A resident asks whether delivery notification proves collection. The battery is an item in a locker, not the locker's power source.
sources.note: 保留起算点为收到码以后、两天期限；通知和已领取的状态不同，电池不是柜体电源。

sources.en: The greenhouse controller opens the roof vent only when both temperature sensors report more than 28 degrees. One high reading is not enough to trigger ventilation.
sources.zh: 只有两个温度传感器都报告温度超过28度时，温室控制器才会打开顶部通风口。仅有一个读数偏高不足以触发通风。
sources.context: A home greenhouse uses a two-sensor interlock; no average-temperature rule is intended.
sources.note: both与only组合要求两个都超过28；不得改成平均温度、任一传感器或大于等于28。

sources.en: Mira reserved a reading booth for her brother, but the reservation remains under her own name. The librarian should check Mira's booking rather than ask her brother to make a second one.
sources.zh: 米拉为弟弟预订了阅读隔间，但预订仍登记在她本人名下。图书管理员应核查米拉的预订，而不是让她弟弟再订一次。
sources.context: Mira is a woman. Her brother will use the booth, and Mira is the booking holder.
sources.note: 保留预订者米拉和使用者弟弟的角色差异，名下指登记人；不添加取消或更名。

sources.en: This doorbell stores a still image when the button is pressed, but it never records sound. Turning off remote notifications does not disable local image storage.
sources.zh: 按下按钮时，这个门铃会保存一张静态图像，但从不录音。关闭远程通知不会禁用本地图像存储。
sources.context: A household is comparing local recording and phone notifications, not asking for security advice.
sources.note: 两个独立否定：从不录音、关通知不关本地存储；按下按钮是保存触发条件。

sources.en: The water-taxi voucher covers one outward crossing to the island; the return crossing must be paid for separately. An unused voucher can be transferred only before a departure time is assigned.
sources.zh: 水上出租船代金券包含一次前往岛上的单程航渡；返程航渡须另行付费。未使用的代金券只有在分配出发时间之前才可转让。
sources.context: The voucher is for passenger transport across water. Outward and return crossings are distinct trips.
sources.note: 一次去程、返程另付；未使用和未分配出发时间共同限制转让，不改成起航前均可转让。

sources.en: The observation balloon stays attached to the meadow by a cable; it is not a service to the hilltop hotel. The ticket is valid for one ascent, not for repeated rides throughout the afternoon.
sources.zh: 观光气球始终通过缆绳系在草地上；它不是前往山顶酒店的交通服务。这张票只可用于一次升空，而不能用于整个下午反复乘坐。
sources.context: A fictional attraction offers vertical rides in a tethered balloon. The nearby hotel has separate transport.
sources.note: 缆绳固定于草地、非去酒店交通；一次升空不是下午无限次数。原自行车装袋草稿与旧DEV共享核心情境，已排除，不用于训练。

sources.en: The tactile tour begins at the sculpture courtyard, not at the audio-guide counter. Visitors who booked an interpreter should wait beside the courtyard entrance until the guide arrives.
sources.zh: 触摸导览从雕塑庭院开始，而不是从语音导览柜台开始。预订了口译员的游客应在庭院入口旁等到导览员到达。
sources.context: The museum offers a tactile tour and separately arranges interpreting. Interpreter and tour guide are different roles.
sources.note: 起点庭院、排除柜台；预订口译员的游客等待导览员而非等待口译员，入口旁不等于柜台。

sources.en: The shuttle app shows an estimated arrival time at the lodge, not the time boarding closes at the station. If the estimate changes, the printed boarding deadline still applies.
sources.zh: 接驳车应用显示的是预计抵达山间旅馆的时间，而不是车站停止上车的时间。如果预计时间发生变化，印在纸上的最晚上车时间仍然有效。
sources.context: The displayed ETA is at the destination; the printed deadline is at the origin. The lodge is a mountain guesthouse.
sources.note: 目的地到达与起点最晚上车不同；估计变化不推迟纸面截止；zh中分拆术语需保持语义。

sources.en: Soak the cracked rye in three cups of water, then drain it before measuring one cup for the salad. The soaking water is not part of the measured grain portion.
sources.zh: 将碎黑麦浸泡在三杯水中，沥干后再量出一杯用于沙拉。浸泡用的水不计入量取的谷物份量。
sources.context: Quantities refer first to soaking water and then to drained grain, not to three cups of grain.
sources.note: 三杯水与一杯沥干谷物的对象不同；先沥后量，浸泡水不计入谷物。

sources.en: Steam the rice-flour parcels over gently bubbling water until the wrappers turn translucent. Do not place the parcels in the water, or the seams may open before the filling heats through.
sources.zh: 将米粉包放在微微冒泡的水上方蒸，直到外皮变得半透明。不要把米粉包放进水里，否则馅料热透之前，接缝就可能裂开。
sources.context: The parcels have rice-flour wrappers with sealed seams and are held on a rack above the water.
sources.note: 上方蒸而非入水煮；外皮半透明终点，馅热透前可能开缝，可能性不改为必然。

sources.en: The smoked paprika supplies aroma rather than heat in this chickpea spread. Replacing it with hot paprika changes the spiciness even if the same amount is used.
sources.zh: 在这款鹰嘴豆抹酱中，烟熏红椒粉提供的是香气，而不是辣味。即使用量相同，换成辣红椒粉也会改变辣度。
sources.context: This recipe uses a mild smoked paprika and a separately labeled hot paprika. Heat means spiciness, not temperature.
sources.note: heat语境指辣味非温度；烟熏香气与辣度区分，等量替换仍变辣度。原烘香种子冷却草稿与旧TRAIN过近，已排除。

sources.en: For the dressing, use two spoonfuls of pear vinegar for every spoonful of oil. This version contains no sesame paste, even though the original recipe does.
sources.zh: 调制酱汁时，每一勺油配两勺梨醋。这个版本不含芝麻酱，尽管原食谱含有芝麻酱。
sources.context: The recipe compares a revised dressing with its original version. A spoonful is a ratio unit, not a fixed serving size.
sources.note: 醋油比2:1不能倒置；本版本无芝麻酱而原版本有，否定绑定当前版本。

sources.en: The analyst received masked treatment labels while checking the exclusion log. Masking concealed the assigned treatment; it did not remove any participants from the dataset.
sources.zh: 分析人员在核查排除记录时收到的是经过盲化的处理组标签。盲化隐藏了所分配的处理，并未从数据集中移除任何参与者。
sources.context: Treatment assignment labels are concealed to prevent the analyst from knowing the group identities.

terms.masked treatment labels: 经过盲化的处理组标签

sources.note: 遮蔽标签不是删人；排除记录只是核查对象；处理与组身份对应语境，不加随机分配等事实。

sources.en: The confidence interval describes uncertainty in the estimated mean sensor drift. It is not an interval that must contain the drift of every individual sensor.
sources.zh: 置信区间描述的是对传感器平均漂移量估计的不确定性。它并不是必须包含每个传感器各自漂移量的区间。
sources.context: A methods paragraph distinguishes uncertainty about a population mean from variation among devices.
sources.note: 均值估计不确定性与个体变异分离；不是必须包含每个个体的否定，未加入覆盖概率或水平。

sources.en: In the dialogue task, a repair initiator signals that a listener needs clarification. It does not necessarily identify which word caused the misunderstanding.
sources.zh: 在对话任务中，修复启动语表明听者需要澄清。它并不一定指出是哪个词引发了误解。
sources.context: Conversation analysis uses repair to mean resolving trouble in speaking or understanding, not fixing equipment.
sources.note: repair由语境限定对话修复，initiator是话语；not necessarily并非never，不能改成绝不会指出词。

sources.en: A filter blank was processed beside the river samples to detect contamination introduced during handling. It was not a second sample taken from an unpolluted river.
sources.zh: 滤膜空白样与河水样本一同处理，以检测操作过程中引入的污染。它并不是从未受污染的河流中另取的一份样本。
sources.context: The blank contains no sampled river water and checks contamination from the processing procedure.
sources.note: 空白样用途是操作污染监测，不是另一条干净河水样；beside指并行处理，非凭空加地理河岸。

sources.en: The treasurer was accused of cooking the books after changing the donation records. The complaint concerns false accounts, not food prepared for the charity dinner.
sources.zh: 财务主管修改捐款记录后被指控做假账。这项投诉涉及虚假账目，而不是为慈善晚宴准备的食物。
sources.context: The phrase cooking the books is an accounting idiom in an allegation; the accusation is not a finding of guilt.
sources.note: 习语做假账，保留被指控而非认定已犯；捐款记录非食谱，第二句排除烹饪含义。

sources.en: After the editor removed the last objection, the proposal had a clear runway. That did not mean funding had been approved; it meant the review could proceed without that obstacle.
sources.zh: 编辑撤去最后一项反对意见后，提案的推进已无这一障碍。这并不意味着资金已经获批，而是意味着审查可以不受该障碍阻碍地继续进行。
sources.context: Clear runway is a metaphor for an unobstructed path in an editorial review, not an airport runway.
sources.note: 跑道隐喻译推进无碍而非机场；有条件审查可继续不等于资金批准；避免夸成所有障碍均不存在。

sources.en: The signed print was a steal at that price, but the buyer still asked for its provenance. Calling it a steal praised the bargain; it did not accuse the seller of theft.
sources.zh: 那幅签名版画以那个价格买到很划算，但买家仍询问其来源记录。说它很划算是在称赞这笔交易，并不是指控卖家盗窃。
sources.context: An art purchase uses a steal as an idiom for a bargain. Provenance means the documented origin and ownership history.
sources.note: a steal是便宜划算，非赃物；仍问provenance；排除盗窃指控，版画不改成签名印刷文件。

sources.en: The caretaker said the fountain was on its last legs, even though all four stone supports were intact. She meant the pump was close to failing, not that the structure had lost its legs.
sources.zh: 尽管四根石质支撑都完好，管理员仍说喷泉快撑不住了。她指的是水泵快要出故障，而不是喷泉结构少了支撑腿。
sources.context: The caretaker is a woman discussing an aging fountain pump. Last legs is an idiom, contrasted with intact physical supports.
sources.note: 四根完好支撑不与水泵将坏矛盾；习语非掉腿，女性caretaker代词她；接近故障不译成已坏。
